newsitem.title: USA: Republic sets pact for GM franchises - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Republic sets pact for GM franchises - WSJ.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc has secured an agreement from General Motors Corp allowing it to acquire GM car and truck franchises throughout the U.S., The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
The news hit only hours after Republic on Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to merge with Grubb Automotive Inc in a transaction valued at about $100 million.
The pact between Republic and GM is expected to lead to acquisitions totaling hundreds of millions of dollars, the newspaper said.
The story said the pact shows Republic has made great progress in convincing Detroit of the merit of its concept for a multi-billion-dollar chain of used car stores dubbed AutoNation.
